app.title: OpenArm: An open-source 7DOF humanoid arm
app.author: Lwrless
app.description: Open-source 7-degree-of-freedom humanoid robotic arm with firmware, mechanical designs, and control software.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run the hardware-in-the-loop simulation to verify joint control.
Flash the firmware onto a compatible microcontroller and run the demo trajectory.
Run the provided ROS nodes and publish joint states to ensure communication.
Measure the latency from command to actuation for each joint.
Validate the mechanical design files by printing a test joint and checking fit.
